'''Shrink''', also known as '''Experiment 001''', is an illegal [[Experiments|genetic experiment]] created by [[Jumba Jookiba]] and a character in the [[Lilo & Stitch (franchise)|''Lilo & Stitch'' franchise]]. He is Jumba's first experiment created with [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] and to be assigned a number. He is designed to shrink and/or enlarge objects and individuals. When he was created, Hämsterviel presumably christened him Shrink. After his creation, the press posted stuff about him in the papers, and it is said that the two scientists opened up a joke shop together and began working on Jumba's many other experiments.

==Background and appearances==
Experiment 001 was the first genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. He was designed to change the sizes of objects and individuals. He was apparently named Shrink by Hämsterviel before arriving on Earth. Eventually, 001 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch (626)|Experiment 626]].

All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of [[Kauai]].

===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''===
At an unknown point, Shrink was presumably activated, captured, and rehabilitated by [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]].

===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''===
Shrink appeared in a clipping on one of the walls of [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]]'s [[Galaxy Defense Industries|lab]] along with several other pictures of his and [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s early accomplishments. One clip showed a headline of "Idiot Scientist Actually Creates Something!" with Hämsterviel's enlarged bottom in Jumba's face. Despite their past 25 years of partnership, Jumba refused to work for Hämsterviel again when the latter offered, as he had mistreated him and was presumably responsible for Jumba's arrest and imprisonment.

Later, the first 624 experiments, including Shrink, were rounded up by [[Leroy (629)|Leroy]] and taken to a [[Aloha Stadium|stadium]] to be destroyed. However, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]], Jumba, [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben (625)|Reuben]] and [[Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed.

It is unknown whether or not Shrink participated in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]].

The Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe.

===[[Stitch!|''Stitch!'' anime]]===
Shrink made [[Shrink (episode)|an appearance]] in Season 2 of the ''Stitch!'' anime where he was sent by [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] to mess with [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] and shrink [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]]. He manages to shrink Jumba, Stitch, and [[Tigerlily]]. It is also revealed that Shrink was abandoned at a young age and has a very willful and childlike behavior following an incident of being locked in a safe when he was younger. He shrinks objects using a green ray from his eyes and has the ability to levitate.

Shrink reappeared in [[Experiment-a-palooza|a later episode]], along with [[Squeak (110)|Squeak]], [[Clip (177)|Clip]], [[Nosox (204)|Nosox]], and [[Retro (210)|Retro]]. After Stitch is reverted to his original programming by Retro, he goes on a rampage and ends up falling into a swimming pool along with Shrink's inactive pod. Shrink, seeing that Stitch is drowning, zaps him with his pink ray, causing Stitch to grow larger. Afterwards, Stitch is eventually turned to good again. Jumba arrives and asks why his experiments are running amok and mentions that Shrink may have been confused after being confined in his pod for a long time, before having Shrink restore Stitch back to his original size. Eventually, Shrink was dehydrated back into an experiment pod and locked in Jumba's vault. Eventually, Jumba grabbed his pod to help Stitch in his fight against [[Dark End]], but Shrink wasn't one of the experiments that was activated.

Shrink also appeared in the special ''[[Stitch and the Planet of Sand]]''.

==Biology==
===Physical appearance===
Shrink is a small purple experiment with a lavender lower jaw and chest, three tentacle-like legs, two stubby little arms, and two floppy antennae with two rings. He has the ability to levitate in order to move around.

===Special abilities===
Shrink can emit a green or pink ray from his eyes that will shrink an object or organism to a very small size. It has also been demonstrated that only the first zap shrinks the object; the second restores its size; and every other enlarges it. He is capable of levitation and/or flight.

===Weaknesses===
Shrink seems to be simple-minded and can easily be manipulated and confused. He can be easily controlled by anyone holding on to his antennae.

==Trivia==
*Shrink originally debuted in ''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''; however, he only appeared as a background character and technically was not seen moving until his appearance in the ''[[Stitch!]]'' anime.
*Shrink is one of the ten known experiments named by someone other than Lilo or Stitch, the other nine being [[Gigi (007)|Gigi]], [[Elastico (345)|Elastico]], [[Yaarp (613)|Yaarp]], [[Hammerface (033)|Hammerface]], [[Heat (609)|Heat]], [[Thresher (544)|Thresher]], [[Plasmoid (617)|Plasmoid]], [[Morpholomew (316)|Morpholomew]], and [[Leroy (629)|Leroy]]. 
**It is implied that it was Hämsterviel who named him Shrink.
**It can also be said that Hämsterviel opened and closed Jumba's career of creating genetic experiments, having named the first and last experiment he funded (Shrink and Leroy, respectively).
*Shrink is technically the oldest of all the known experiments, having been the first experiment ever created.
*Shrink, [[Zero (000)|Zero]] (in cyborg form), and [[Pix (214)|Pix]] are the only known experiments whose legs resemble a tripod.
*Shrink, [[Zap (603)|Zap]], [[Remmy (276)|Remmy]], [[Cloudy (320)|Cloudy]], and [[Welko (074)|Welko]] are the only known experiments that are always seen levitating.
**[[Phantasmo (375)|Phantasmo]] and [[Witch (610)|Witch]] primarily levitate but often possess objects or living beings to move by other means. [[Tickle-Tummy (275)|Tickle-Tummy]] is also able to levitate, but has been seen bouncing as well.
*Shrink is one of the few experiments to not have his one true place revealed.
*He is also one of the few experiments to not appear in the group photo at the end of ''Leroy & Stitch''.
*Shrink's [[Experiment Pods|pod]] color is red in the ''Stitch!'' anime.
*In Shrink's [[Shrink (episode)|first appearance]] in the anime, his size ray is green, but in his [[Experiment-A-Palooza|second appearance]], it is pink.
*In the English dub of the anime episode "Experiment-A-Palooza", [[Squeak (110)|Squeak]] mentions that Shrink can shrink and enlarge things, and that both his and Shrink's names are misnomers.

'''Shush''', also known as '''Experiment 234''', is an illegal [[Experiments|genetic experiment]] created by [[Jumba Jookiba]] and a character in the [[Lilo & Stitch (franchise)|''Lilo & Stitch'' franchise]]. He is designed to eavesdrop on private enemy conversations using the built-in speaker in his tail; he will cease doing so if he is petted on the head. His one true place is with [[Cobra Bubbles]] as a CIA operative.

==Background and appearances==
Experiment 234 was the 234th genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. He was designed to eavesdrop on private enemy conversations. 234 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch (626)|Experiment 626]].

All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of [[Kauai]].

===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''===
[[File:Lilo & Stitch The Series - Shush - Shush after activation.png|thumb|left|Shush after being activated]]
234's pod was found by [[Gantu]] in a playground, where [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] were present. Gantu then attempted to escape with the experiment pod, but Lilo and Stitch managed to get the pod back from Gantu after a brief struggle. Unfortunately, a pair of kids then soaked Lilo and 234's pod with their super-soakers, activating the experiment.

234, named Shush, used the speaker in his tail to eavesdrop on the fleeing kids and Gantu. He later eavesdropped on [[Mrs. Hasagawa]] and also [[Officer Kahiko]], which Lilo and Stitch found quite fascinating.

When Lilo brought Shush [[Lilo's House|home]], the latter eavesdropped on [[Nani Pelekai|Nani]] talking to [[David Kawena|David]] on the phone, to which Lilo mistook as her older sister trying to insult David. After Nani cleared things up with Lilo, she reprimanded her younger sister for eavesdropping on other people's private conversations.

[[File:Lilo & Stitch The Series - Shush - Shush eavesdropping on Mertle.png|thumb|Shush eavesdropping]]
Lilo later used Shush to eavesdrop on [[Mertle Edmonds|Mertle]] dismissing her dolls, despite Stitch telling Lilo otherwise. She mistook Mertle's statement as a dismissal of [[Elena|the]] [[Teresa|hula]] [[Yuki|girls]]. They all believed Lilo at first after they were informed and shunned Mertle before taking sides, but were more strict about being told what to do.

Shortly after, an escaped [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] on a PC monitor screen talked Mertle into catching the remaining experiments in place of Gantu (who had been fired for his incompetence earlier), to which she angrily accepted. Hämsterviel then put a special mind-control headband device on Mertle's head, which hypnotized her into becoming his "android".

After hanging out with the hula girls for a while, Lilo decided to go check on Mertle and took Stitch and Shush with her. They soon ran into [[Mrs. Edmonds]], who was carrying several boxes of Mertle's old dolls that she was giving away, thus revealing what Mertle was really talking about earlier. Lilo suddenly felt guilty about eavesdropping and owed Mertle an apology.

[[File:Lilo & Stitch The Series - Shush - Shush working with Cobra as CIA operative.png|thumb|left|Shush with Cobra]]
Just then, a brainwashed Mertle ambushed the three and immobilized both Shush and Stitch, much to Hämsterviel's approval. Gantu later intervened and attempted to recapture Shush so as to redeem himself. After a long battle, Lilo and Stitch were able to defeat Hämsterviel and rescue Shush.

Later, [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] removed the mind-control headband from Mertle's head, which reverted her back to her normal self, and Shush shortly after found his one true place with [[Cobra Bubbles]] (whom Lilo had telephoned earlier) as a CIA operative.

===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''===
The first 624 experiments, including Shush, were rounded up by [[Leroy (629)|Leroy]] and taken to a [[Aloha Stadium|stadium]] to be destroyed. However, Lilo, [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben (625)|Reuben]] and [[Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed.

It is unknown whether or not Shush participated in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]].

The Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe.

==Biology==
===Physical appearance===
Shush is a pink raccoon/mouse-like experiment with large ears containing microphone insides, black eyes, dark brown markings, a large lavender nose, a thin mouth, and a speaker at the end of his tail.

===Special abilities===
Shush can amplify anything he hears through the "speaker" in his tail. His large ears also seem to have sensors sticking out that supposedly give him extremely enhanced auditory perception, and he can direct his hearing to an exact location, drowning everything else out.

===Weaknesses===
If Shush is petted on the head, he will fold down his ears with contentment and stop eavesdropping.

==Trivia==
*Shush's [[Experiment Pods|pod]] color is green.
*Shush is one of the few experiments to not appear in the group photo at the end of ''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''.

'''Sinker''', also known as '''Experiment 602''', is an illegal [[Experiments|genetic experiment]] created by [[Jumba Jookiba]] and a character in the [[Lilo & Stitch (franchise)|''Lilo & Stitch'' franchise]]. He is designed to sink entire naval fleets with his long, razor-sharp dorsal fin; he can hold his breath underwater indefinitely to carry out his primary function. His one true place is at a [[Japanese Restaurant|Japanese restaurant]], cutting up fish fillets and vegetables to make sushi.

==Background and appearances==
Experiment 602 was the 602nd genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. He was designed to slice enemy sea vessels in two with his large, sword-like dorsal fin. 602 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch (626)|Experiment 626]].

All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of [[Kauai]].

At an unknown point after this, Experiment 602 was activated.

===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''===
[[File:Lilo & Stitch The Series - Sinker - Sinker's shadow underwater.png|thumb|left|Sinker's shadow]]
When [[Keoni Jameson|Keoni]] was practicing for an upcoming boat race, 602 sunk his boat while [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] were watching. Later, when Lilo and Stitch attempted to capture 602, the latter proceeded to sink their [[X-Buggy|motorboat]] as well. When [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] and [[Pleakley]] tried to go and rescue them, 602 sunk their raft too.

602, named Sinker, then proceeded to sink [[Gantu]] and [[Reuben (625)|Experiment 625]] numerous times when they attempted to catch the former, and likely sunk other watercraft.

Later, Lilo, Stitch, Jumba and Pleakley stowed away aboard a cruise ship, where Lilo tried to warn the captain about Sinker's rampage, to no avail. However, they got caught and thrown in the brig due to Stitch's horseplay. After the four managed to break out, Jumba hatched a plan to capture Sinker.

[[File:Lilo & Stitch The Series - Sinker - Stitch facing Sinker underwater.png|thumb|Stitch facing Sinker]]
Wearing scuba gear (and defying his aquaphobia), Stitch dove underwater to look for Sinker, while the latter retreated to a cave until he eventually came out, revealing the diminutive size of his body. However, Sinker was unamused after Stitch laughed at the former's puny size. As he escaped, Stitch chased after Sinker and was able to grab hold of his large dorsal fin. 

While swimming through the ocean, Sinker sunk a fishing boat where two fishermen were using a net to catch fish. He then attempted to sink the runaway cruise ship, but Stitch managed to capture Sinker in the ship's anchor and chain.

[[File:Lilo & Stitch The Series - Sinker - Sinker working as a sushi chef.png|thumb|left|Sinker in his one true place]]
Shortly after, Sinker found his one true place at a [[Japanese Restaurant|sushi restaurant]], cutting up fish fillets and vegetables with his elongated dorsal fin.

In "[[Drowsy (episode)|Drowsy]]", Sinker's picture was seen in [[Lilo's Experiment Book|Lilo's experiment logbook]].

In "[[Ploot (episode)|Ploot]]", Lilo tried to convince Sinker to help her defeat [[Ploot (505)|Ploot]], but he was unable to because he was very busy cutting up food for a large party while Hatha, the other chef who worked there, called in sick.

In "[[Snafu (episode)|Snafu]]", Sinker's picture was seen in Lilo's experiment logbook again.

===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''===
In the film's opening, Sinker can be seen popping his head out of the water and waving hello to [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]].

Later, the first 624 experiments, including Sinker, were rounded up by [[Leroy (629)|Leroy]] and taken to a [[Aloha Stadium|stadium]] to be destroyed. However, Lilo, [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben (625)|Reuben]] and [[Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed.

Sinker participated in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]].

The Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe.

===[[Stitch!|''Stitch!'' anime]]===
Sinker made [[The Return of Amnesio|a cameo appearance]] in the ''Stitch!'' anime as an image on a computer screen and as one of the experiments in [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s [[Prison Asteroid K-37|prison cell]]. He made [[Stitch Ahoy!|another appearance]] along with [[Slushy (523)|Slushy]], in which Hämsterviel [[Transmutation|used]] both of them to attack a cruise ship that he had lured [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] onto. It is also revealed that Sinker is capable of [[:Category:Talking experiments|speaking fluently]] and has a blind spot on his dorsal fin. Thus, he will become immobile if forced into a horizontal position because of his large fin. After being defeated, Sinker was reverted back to normal, then dehydrated back into an experiment pod and locked in [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]]'s vault. Eventually, Jumba grabbed his pod to help Stitch in his fight against [[Dark End]], but Sinker  wasn't one of the experiments that was activated. He later appeared in the special ''[[Stitch and the Planet of Sand]]''.

==Personality==
Sinker has a knack for cutting and slicing things in half with his long dorsal fin. He is shown to be greatly offended by the mocking of his size compared to the rest of him. He is also incredibly territorial in that he will claim an entire body of water and remain there until he has sunk every vessel in the area.

==Biology==
===Physical appearance===
Sinker is a small purple shark-like experiment with small dark red eyes, a thin mouth with a turquoise tongue, small arms and legs, and a large, sword-like dorsal fin.

===Special abilities===
Sinker can use his long, razor-sharp dorsal fin to slice sea vessels up to the size of a yacht in two. He can also use his dorsal fin like a knife to cut up and chop food. He can swim underwater like a shark and is capable of holding his breath indefinitely, indicating that he has lungs instead of gills. In the ''[[Stitch!]]'' anime, he is also seen to be able to [[:Category:Talking experiments|speak fluently]], though it is unknown if this is because of [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] [[Transmutation|transmuting]] him or if he was always capable of speaking and learned over time.

===Weaknesses===
Despite being aquatic-based, Sinker cannot seem to breathe underwater. Also, according to [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], Sinker has a design flaw in that his dorsal fin is too large. This creates a blind spot in his mobility on land, causing him to become immobile if forced into a horizontal position.

==Trivia==
*Sinker is an obvious parody of [[w:c:villains:Great White Sharks (Jaws)|the titular great white shark]] from ''[[wikipedia:Jaws (film)|Jaws]]''.
*Sinker was [[:Category:Experiments Activated Off-Screen|activated off-screen]].
*Sinker is one of the rare experiments to not have black eyes like most experiments, having dark red eyes instead.
*Sinker's dorsal fin is shown to have differences in size, though it is likely a continuity error.
*Despite being an aquatic-based experiment, Sinker has no gills and appears to be unable to breathe underwater, yet is able to hold his breath indefinitely.
*Sinker is one of the few experiments to not appear in the group photo at the end of ''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''.
*Sinker's [[Experiment Pods|pod]] color is blue in the ''[[Stitch!]]'' anime.

'''Skip''', also known as '''Experiment 089''', is an illegal [[Experiments|genetic experiment]] created by [[Jumba Jookiba]] and a character in the [[Lilo & Stitch (franchise)|''Lilo & Stitch'' franchise]]. He is designed to skip time by ten minutes, but had a flaw in his programming that made him skip ahead ten years instead. When used by someone, the individual and whoever is beside him will travel forward in time by one decade. Luckily, he has a reset button that will bring the time travelers back to the original time they started in.

==Background and appearances==
Experiment 089 was the 89th genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. He was originally designed to skip time ahead by ten minutes (because Jumba was too impatient to wait for his microwave to reheat his leftovers), but there was an error in his programming; when the button on 089's head was pressed, he instead skipped ahead ten years. 089 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch (626)|Experiment 626]].

All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of [[Kauai]].

===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''===
[[File:Lilo & Stitch The Series - Skip - Lilo pressing Skip's button.jpg|thumb|left|Lilo pressing Skip's button]]
At an unknown point, Experiment 089 was activated and then later taken in by the [[Aloha Animal Rescue|dog shelter]].

When [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] went to visit the pound and asked the [[Susan Hegarty|dog pound lady]] if there had been any new "dogs" brought here lately, the latter presented 089 to Lilo. She then adopted 089 from the dog shelter and took him back to [[Lilo's House|her house]]. After [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] explained 089's powers to Lilo, she named him Skip. Having grown tired of childhood restrictions, Lilo used the experiment to skip her and [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] ahead ten years and become a teenager.

Unfortunately, life for Lilo and Stitch in this future quickly proved to be inconvenient when they went into [[Kokaua Town|town]] using [[Nani Pelekai|Nani]]'s [[X-Buggy|dune buggy]], as they were relentlessly given tickets by local police and discovered [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] working undercover as a parking officer. Believing she needed to be even older to fulfill her desires, Lilo used Skip (despite Stitch's reluctance) to flash forward another ten years and become a full-fledged adult.

[[File:Lilo & Stitch The Series - Skip - Skip's wanted poster screen.jpg|thumb|Skip's wanted poster on a monitor]]
However, Lilo, Stitch and Skip were sent into an alternate future where, in their absence, Hämsterviel had become supreme ruler of the world, with Kokaua Town renamed "Hämsterviel Ville" as its capital, and almost every experiment in his custody (with Stitch and Skip still wanted). The trio were puzzled and horrified by this setback, but before they could investigate further, Stitch and Skip were captured by future police backed up by [[Clink (086)|Clink]] and taken to [[Gantu]], despite Lilo's best efforts to protect them. She managed to escape while promising to come back for them, with the police letting her go, as their boss only cared about the experiments.

When Lilo returned home, a tattered Jumba explained that while she and Stitch were gone for twenty years, their house was repossessed to cover unpaid parking tickets regarding Nani's dune buggy that Lilo had borrowed as a teen ten years from the current day. Jumba then added that he had been hiding in the attic ever since Hämsterviel had taken power and captured all the other experiments because Lilo and Stitch were not here at the time to do it themselves. Unfortunately, Nani had to work for Hämsterviel to pay off any debts.

[[File:Lilo & Stitch The Series - Skip - Lilo, Stitch and Skip in the present.jpg|thumb|left|Lilo, Stitch and Skip in the present]]
Later on, Stitch and Skip were rescued by Lilo, Jumba and [[Pleakley]] (who became an intergalactic fashion celebrity with top ten TV shows in the intergalactic fashion channel) while Gantu was distracted. Lilo then used Skip's reverse function, which Jumba revealed, to return her and Stitch to the present. After this experience, Lilo realized that being a child actually had its advantages, and that she and Stitch must continue their experiment hunting in order to prevent that horrible future from becoming an official reality.

===''[[The Origin of Stitch]]''===
Skip was one of the experiments that was gliding on the screen, but he is 531 instead of 089.

===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''===
The first 624 experiments, including Skip, were rounded up by [[Leroy (629)|Leroy]] and taken to a [[Aloha Stadium|stadium]] to be destroyed. However, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben (625)|Reuben]] and [[Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed.

Skip did not participate in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]], instead choosing to retreat with the weaker experiments.

The Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe.

==Personality==
Rather than being a troublesome experiment, Skip is rather wobbly and clumsy and enjoys exploring his surroundings. He is also surprisingly happy-go-lucky and easygoing, often smiling and not caring about being confined. Unlike most of his cousins, he doesn't cause trouble on purpose, but tends to cause unforeseen consequences when someone activates his powers. He seems slightly dazed at times, not paying attention to what others are saying and not being observant of his surroundings.

==Biology==
===Physical appearance===
Skip is a red-purple hourglass-shaped experiment with a large head with small white eyes with black pupils, two green dots on his head that serve as buttons, a red nose and a wide mouth with a plump body. He always wobbles when he walks.

===Special abilities===
Each time someone presses the button on Skip's head, Skip and anyone near him will be transported ten years into the future. While to them it only feels like a few seconds, those who are transported actually go missing for one decade and are not immune to the relative aging their species is subjected to in the time that lapses between each "skip". Luckily, Skip also has a reverse setting that sends him and his users back to the present day.

==Trivia==
*Skip was [[:Category:Experiments Activated Off-Screen|activated off-screen]].
*Skip is one of the rare experiments to have sclerae and pupils instead of solid black eyes, the others being [[Mr. Stenchy (254)|Mr. Stenchy]], [[Mrs. Sickly (255)|Mrs. Sickly]], [[Clink (086)|Clink]], [[Nosox (204)|Nosox]], [[Bragg (145)|Bragg]], [[Thresher (544)|Thresher]], [[Experiments#Other experiments|Tippy]], [[Experiments#3-Series: Psychological|Slobber]], and [[Unconfirmed Experiments#Comic Zone Volume 1: Disney's Lilo & Stitch|four unconfirmed experiments]].
*Skip is one of the few experiments to not have his one true place revealed.
*He is also one of the few experiments to not appear in the group photo at the end of ''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''.

'''Skunkuna''' is an illegal [[Experiments|genetic experiment]] created by [[Jacques von Hämsterviel]] and a character in the [[Lilo & Stitch (franchise)|''Lilo & Stitch'' franchise]], first appearing in the ''[[Stitch!]]'' anime. He is designed to launch out spheres of pink repulsive odors from underneath his fur and is susceptible to [[Mr. Stenchy (254)|Mr. Stenchy]]'s charms, something that [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]]'s other experiments are immune to. When his odor is mixed with Mr. Stenchy's, it can incredibly be used as an air freshener. 

==Background and appearances==
Skunkuna is a genetic experiment created by [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]], and one of the only experiments to not be created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] or assigned a number. He was designed to fire off spheres of pink repulsive odors everywhere.

===[[Stitch!|''Stitch!'' anime]]===
Skunkuna [[A Stinky Episode|first appeared]] when [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] created him under unknown circumstances. He was then sent by Hämsterviel to battle [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]], who was with [[Yuna Kamihara|Yuna]] at the time. They both had breathing masks so that they wouldn't be overcome by [[Mr. Stenchy (254)|Mr. Stenchy]]'s horrible smell. However, Stitch's mask fell off at some point, leaving him open to attack. At the end of the episode, Skunkuna is seen infatuated with Mr. Stenchy, and it is revealed that a mixture of Mr. Stenchy and Skunkuna's odor oddly enough creates an air freshener.

==Biology==
===Physical appearance===
Skunkuna is a black skunk-like experiment with a proboscis-like beak, some peculiar fish- and housefly-like traits, and bright purple eyes.

===Special abilities===
Skunkuna can fire off spheres of pink repulsive odors from underneath his fur. It is also shown that when his odor is mixed with [[Mr. Stenchy (254)|Mr. Stenchy]]'s, it can apparently be used as an air freshener.

==Trivia==
*Skunkuna is one of the rare experiments to not have black eyes like most experiments, having bright purple eyes instead.
*Skunkuna is the first experiment that was not created by Jumba, as he was created by Hämsterviel. The second is [[Dark End]] who was created by [[Delia]].
*There is a misconception that this experiment is really Experiment 126 (a.k.a. Stank). This contradicts what was established in the English dub of [[A Stinky Episode|the episode]], where this experiment was created by Hämsterviel and called Skunkuna. Since we do not have a direct translation of the Japanese language episode, it is a bit difficult to confirm whether or not this design is Jumba's Experiment 126 or Hämsterviel's Skunkuna. However, [[disney:Jess Winfield|Jess Winfield]], who worked on the dub, explained via email with member [[User:Ronlof|Ronlof]] that "the skunk-like experiment is Skunkuna, created by Hämsterviel in the Japanese series... so he's outside of Jumba's numbering scheme." He also confirmed that the English team received translated scripts from Japan when "reversioning" the episode. Additionally, Ronlof consulted a Japanese speaker who says this experiment is referred to as スカンクーナ in Japan, which translates to "Skunkuna" which is his name in the dub. Since there is no official source referring to Skunkuna as Experiment 126 or Stank, it is most likely that what is said in the dub is, in fact, true, and this experiment, named Skunkuna, was indeed created by Hämsterviel. The idea that Skunkuna is Experiment 126 appears to be fabricated by the fandom.

'''Slick''', also known as '''Experiment 020''', is an illegal [[Experiments|genetic experiment]] created by [[Jumba Jookiba]] and a character in the [[Lilo & Stitch (franchise)|''Lilo & Stitch'' franchise]]. He is designed to sell anything to anyone like an expert by using his sales pitch and auctioneer-like stratagems. However, once he starts selling, he is programmed to do it nonstop. His one true place is selling for charity and fundraisers at [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]]'s [[Kaiāulu Hale|hula school]].

==Background and appearances==
Experiment 020 was the twentieth genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. He was designed to sell anything to anyone until there was nothing available for sale. According to Jumba, 020 once sold his [[Galaxy Defense Industries|laboratory]] instead of other experiments, and another time he sold Jumba's ex-wife for the outrageous price of ten kiltacredits, when she was only worth five. 020 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch (626)|Experiment 626]].

All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of [[Kauai]].

At an unknown point after this, Experiment 020 was activated.

===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''===
[[File:Lilo & Stitch The Series - Slick - 'These are the chocolates of tomorrow.'.png|thumb|left|"These are the chocolates of tomorrow."]]
While [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] were having trouble selling candy bars for a fundraiser at their [[Kaiāulu Hale|school]], they encountered 020 sitting on a park bench reading a newspaper. When 020 heard about Lilo and Stitch's soliciting problem, he introduced himself to them and then presented his card revealing his number and primary function.

Afterwards, 020, named Slick, offered to assist Lilo and Stitch in their fundraising drive. Using his sales pitch, Slick managed to convince every person whom Lilo came across into buying one of her chocolate bars.

However, Slick later grew obsessive and began selling everything the Pelekais owned. Since they were unable to capture Slick (as he had sold all their [[Prison Capsule|containment orbs]] as well), Lilo left [[Pleakley]] in charge of Slick while she and Stitch both set out to redeem all of their personal belongings. Among one of them was a trophy that [[Charles and Mary|a couple]] was using to stabilize an outdoor dining table.

[[File:Lilo & Stitch The Series - Slick - 'Do I hear two dollars?'.png|thumb|"Do I hear two dollars?"]]
While they were doing this, [[Mertle Edmonds|Mertle]], who had learned about Slick earlier, arrived at the [[Lilo's House|Pelekais' house]] looking for the salesman experiment. Annoyed, Pleakley tried to get Mertle to leave, but Slick, advising him not to turn away a customer, let her come in. When the two debated over custody of Slick, the latter held an impromptu auction and set the opening bid at one dollar. It ended with Slick selling himself to Mertle for three dollars.

After managing to retrieve all of their household possessions, Lilo and Stitch returned home and put everything back in its proper place, then discovered that Slick was missing. Pleakley explained what happened, prompting Lilo and Stitch to get Slick back.

Meanwhile, Mertle used Slick to sell candy bars and help her win the contest until Lilo and Stitch stole him, but Mertle managed to steal him back. Later, when Lilo and Stitch (disguised as beekeepers) went over to [[Mertle's House|Mertle's house]] to reclaim Slick, she revealed that she had sold him to [[Reuben (625)|Experiment 625]], much to their horror.

At [[Gantu's Ship|Gantu's ship]], Slick acquainted himself with Reuben and later sold the ship to an elderly man, who had somehow gained entry. Slick was soon captured in a container by an ailing [[Gantu]], who had been repeatedly persuaded by [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] to do so.

[[File:Lilo & Stitch The Series - Slick - 'It's been real and fun, but it ain't been real fun.'.png|thumb|left|"It's been real, and it's been fun, but it ain't been real fun."]]
Fortunately, Lilo and Stitch showed up and were able to free Slick, but he then escaped while also selling the batteries in Gantu's [[Plasma Blaster|blaster]] to a pair of locals. Gantu later tracked Slick down and recaptured him. However, the former ultimately bartered Slick for Lilo's last chocolate bar, claiming it would cure his cold.

Shortly after, Slick found his one true place at Lilo's school in raising money for charity.

In "[[Ploot (episode)|Ploot]]", Lilo tried to convince Slick to help her defeat [[Ploot (505)|Ploot]], but he led Lilo astray by trying to get her to buy a [[Kokaua Town]] umbrella.

In "[[Remmy (episode)|Remmy]]", Slick was one of the experiments in Lilo's dream.

===''[[The Origin of Stitch]]''===
Slick was one of the experiments that was gliding on the screen, but he is 597 instead of 020.

===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''===
The first 624 experiments, including Slick, were rounded up by [[Leroy (629)|Leroy]] and taken to a [[Aloha Stadium|stadium]] to be destroyed. However, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben (625)|Reuben]] and [[Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed.

Slick participated in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]], having frightened at least one Leroy clone.

However, the Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe.

===[[Stitch!|''Stitch!'' anime]]===
Slick made a special guest appearance in the ''Stitch!'' segment "[[Kung Fu Dragon Pleak Lee]]".

==Personality==
Slick is a fast-talking, Southern-accented salesman. He is generally very friendly and polite, tipping his hat every time he greets somebody, but is quite obsessive about selling stuff. He won't stop doing so until there is nothing left to sell, even selling himself to Mertle through a live auction. He is also very kind-hearted and courteous, and strongly supports his one true place in working for charity.

Despite being incredibly friendly, Slick can also be amazingly fierce. This was shown during the climactic battle in ''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''. His initial facial expression after Stitch's pep talk was fearsome, and at one point during the battle, he had a Leroy clone running from him. Thus, he can easily turn from a friendly salesperson to a terrifying fighter, while still keeping his good intentions.

==Biology==
===Physical appearance===
Slick is a fast-talking, pink doglike experiment resembling [[Cannonball (520)|Cannonball]], but with a smaller face, a purple nose, and two black eyes. He wears a straw boater hat and bow tie, carries a cane, and speaks in the manner of a Southern-accented salesperson who never turns down a customer.

===Special abilities===
Slick can sell anything to anyone, even if they have no reason or wouldn't buy it otherwise, by using sympathy and slight exaggeration effects. He can [[:Category:Talking experiments|speak fluently]] and is capable of controlling his facial emotions and voice to persuade his customers. He has professional sales tactics and auctioneer-like speaking qualities.

==Trivia==
*Slick is one of the only four known experiments that wears a hat, the other three being [[Frenchfry (062)|Frenchfry]], [[Squeak (110)|Squeak]], and [[Derrick (566)|Derrick]]. However, Slick is the only one wearing a true hat that he can remove, while Frenchfry's "hat" appears to be a part of his head, and it is presumed Squeak can take off his hat since he appears with a fresh hat in [[Leroy & Stitch|the TV film finale]] after an earlier incident with the Evil-liminator, while it is unknown if Derrick can remove his hat or not.
*Slick was [[:Category:Experiments Activated Off-Screen|activated off-screen]].
*Slick is one of the few known experiments that can [[:Category:Talking experiments|speak fluently]].

Slimy reappeared in "[[Snafu (episode)|Snafu]]", and was freed along with Gantu's other captive experiments by [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], Stitch, and several other experiments in a rescue mission.

===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''===
The first 624 experiments, including Slimy, were rounded up by [[Leroy (629)|Leroy]] and taken to a [[Aloha Stadium|stadium]] to be destroyed. However, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben (625)|Reuben]] and [[Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed.

Slimy participated in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]].

The Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe.

===[[Stitch!|''Stitch!'' anime]]===
Slimy made [[The Return of Amnesio|a cameo appearance]] in the ''Stitch!'' anime as an image on a computer screen.

==Biology==
===Physical appearance===
Slimy is a large green slug-like experiment with black eyes on his stalk, a thin mouth, three spines on his back, and a semi-gelatinous body without legs or arms.

===Special abilities===
Slimy can produce a thick, slippery green slime similar to that of a snail.

==Trivia==
*After [[Reuben (625)|Reuben]] and [[Sparky (221)|Sparky]], Slimy is tied with [[Digger (529)|Digger]] for the most appearances of experiments that [[:Category:Stitch! The Movie Experiments|debuted]] in ''[[Stitch! The Movie]]''. Both appeared in two different episodes of ''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]'' as well as ''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''. Though Slimy briefly appeared on a computer screen in the ''[[Stitch!]]'' anime.
*Slimy is one of three known limbless experiments, the other two being [[Zap (603)|Zap]] and [[Cloudy (320)|Cloudy]].
**However, unlike Zap and Cloudy, who are capable of levitating in the air, Slimy crawls on the ground similar to slugs and snails, which inspired Slimy's design.
*Slimy's [[Experiment Pods|pod]] color is red.

It is unknown how or why this happens, but he is shown twice in ''Leroy & Stitch'' like this, and his original green version did not appear. It is possible that it was a general recolor in order to fill out the group of experiments to make it appear as if there were more experiments than were actually designed.
*Slimy also changes in size from large in ''Stitch! The Movie'' to small in "[[627 (episode)|627]]". It is unknown if there was a reason for this or just a change in animation style.
*Slimy is one of the few experiments to not have his one true place revealed.

'''Slugger''', also known as '''Experiment 608''', is an illegal [[Experiments|genetic experiment]] created by [[Jumba Jookiba]] and a character in the [[Lilo & Stitch (franchise)|''Lilo & Stitch'' franchise]]. He is designed to deflect incoming enemy projectiles and swat away balls, toys, and fruits thrown over the fence by annoying kids. His one true place is at the [[Baseball Field|baseball field]] as a coaching assistant for Little League softball.

==Background and appearances==
Experiment 608 was the 608th genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. He was designed to deflect incoming enemy projectiles. 608 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch (626)|Experiment 626]].

All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of [[Kauai]], with 608's pod landing on a [[Baseball Field|baseball field]].

===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''===
[[File:Lilo & Stitch The Series - Slugger - Slugger shivers from icy cooler.png|thumb|left|Slugger moments after his activation]]
608's pod was mixed in with a bunch of softballs. When the team's Little League coach found it and realized it wasn't a softball, he tossed it. The pod landed into a drink cooler, the melting ice activating 608, who shivered from the chill.

608 then spotted a woman in a wheelchair throwing a ball for her dog to fetch. Before the dog could retrieve the ball, 608 deflected it with his bat-like tail, astounding the dog.

Later, multiple coconuts thrown by [[Mrs. Hasagawa]] and deflected by 608 hit [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] on the head, therefore grabbing his and [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]]'s attention. Before they could react, [[Gantu]] arrived and grabbed 608 (even stating how weak the latter was as he struggled to get free). Just then, Stitch slammed a crate onto Gantu's head, and 608 got loose from his grasp.

[[File:Lilo & Stitch The Series - Slugger - Slugger preparing to hit a softball.png|thumb|Slugger playing baseball]]
Afterwards, Lilo started talking to 608 and pacified him. When Lilo assured him that she and Stitch will keep him safe, they took 608, named Slugger, [[Lilo's House|home]] and discovered his incredible batting skills. Lilo then decided to put Slugger on her softball team, since [[Pleakley]] had jeopardized the previous game with his incompetence, and after Lilo and [[Mertle Edmonds|Mertle]] had wagered a rematch.

Thus, Slugger became Lilo's new softball player against Mertle's team. He did really well during practice until Mertle changed the game to basketball, put Gantu on her team, and even made Slugger be part of the wager. Slugger struggled at basketball because he was only able to hit things, but Lilo's team still won thanks to Stitch and a very talented Pleakley.

Gantu, being a sore loser, attempted to make off with Slugger, but the latter was saved when Stitch tripped Gantu using one of the basketball goals. Enraged, Gantu ripped out the other basketball pole and prepared to retaliate. However, he was thwarted by Stitch, who then let Slugger use the pole to whack Gantu over a vast distance.

[[File:Lilo & Stitch The Series - Slugger - Slugger coaching Little League softball.png|thumb|left|Slugger in his one true place]]
Slugger later found his one true place as the new hitter for the Little League softball team, whose coach (the same one who activated Slugger earlier) wasn't a very good hitter himself. With Slugger coaching, the team would quickly become first place.

Slugger reappeared in "[[Glitch (episode)|Glitch]]", coaching for the Little League team, when a baseball pitching machine went haywire while he was practicing his batting skills. Regardless, Slugger spun his bat-like tail around his body and deflected every softball the machine shot at him, causing the team's members to panic as they dodged the flurry of rapidly incoming balls. When the coach unplugged the machine to stop it, [[Glitch (223)|223]]'s pod was shot out. Slugger gave it the biggest hit of all, sending it all the way to Lilo's house where it met its activation.

===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''===
Slugger was seen early in the movie coaching Little League softball with his batting skills as [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] was making her rounds with [[Scrump]] to make sure all the experiments were happy in the one true place they belonged.

Later, the first 624 experiments, including Slugger, were rounded up by [[Leroy (629)|Leroy]] and taken to a [[Aloha Stadium|stadium]] to be destroyed. However, Lilo, [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben (625)|Reuben]] and [[Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed.

Slugger participated in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]] by deflecting Leroys' plasma projectiles back at them. He also carried off a couple of Leroys with his bat-like tail.

However, the Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe.

===[[Stitch!|''Stitch!'' anime]]===
Slugger made [[The Return of Amnesio|a cameo appearance]] in the ''Stitch!'' anime as one of the experiments in [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s [[Prison Asteroid K-37|prison cell]]. He made [[Meega Going to Disneyland!|another appearance]], along with [[Pix (214)|Pix]], [[Boomer (288)|Boomer]], [[Slushy (523)|Slushy]], [[Blowhard (533)|Blowhard]], and [[Kixx (601)|Kixx]], when [[Yuna Kamihara|Yuna]] and [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] visited Tokyo Disneyland.

==Personality==
Slugger is an adept baseball player who is actually stronger than he appears to be, as he was able to grip a basketball pole without any struggle and whack Gantu over a vast distance. He will hit anything that comes his way on instinct due to his programming, but is also one of the least hostile among the other experiments. He seems cautious of people, but gets along quite well with others once he gets to know them.

==Biology==
===Physical appearance===
Slugger is a small yellow pterosaur-like experiment with an orange stripe running down his face, black eyes, a thin beak-like mouth, and a baseball bat-like tail. In ''[[Stitch!]]'', he has teeth in his beak.

===Special abilities===
Slugger's tail can deflect incoming projectiles of almost any texture or substance. His tail is powerful enough to knock a ball out of existence, yet delicate enough to do the same to something as fragile as an avocado without fracturing it. His tail is plasma-proof and supposedly bulletproof to aid in carrying out his function. He can also rotate his tail more than 360 degrees around his waist at impossible speeds. He has amazing strength, absurd precision and coordination, and is capable of flight.

Slugger can only speak in a series of snorts and grunts.

===Weaknesses===
Slugger has trouble with anything other than hitting objects, therefore making catching, kicking, or any other action almost impossible for him. It was claimed by Gantu that Slugger was weaker than most other experiments, but this was proven to be wrong.

==Trivia==
*Slugger, [[Bugby (128)|Bugby]], [[Babyfier (151)|Babyfier]], [[Jam (202)|Jam]], [[Melty (228)|Melty]], [[Wishy-Washy (267)|Wishy-Washy]], [[Snooty (277)|Snooty]], [[Amnesio (303)|Amnesio]], [[Hunkahunka (323)|Hunkahunka]], [[Experiments#5-Series: Elemental and environmental manipulators|Blake]], [[Witch (610)|Witch]], and two [[Unconfirmed Experiments#Comic Zone Volume 1: Disney's Lilo & Stitch|unconfirmed]] [[Unconfirmed Experiments#Miscellaneous|experiments]] are the only known experiments that have wings.
*Despite Gantu claiming Slugger to be weak, he was able to grasp a basketball pole and whack Gantu over a vast distance without any struggle, and [[Meega Going to Disneyland!|another time]] he suspended Stitch in mid-flight, again without any struggle.
*Slugger is one of two known experiments whose [[Experiment Pods|pod]] got mixed up with some softballs, the other being [[Glitch (223)|Glitch]].
*Slugger's pod color is blue.
*The [[Experiment Pod Container]] describes Slugger as: "Experiment 608. Primary function: Deflection of incoming enemy projectiles."
**According to Jumba, Slugger "will swat at many different things. In addition to deflecting airborne projectiles launched by enemies, he is also programmed to swat away balls, toys, and fruit thrown over fence by annoying neighbor children."

'''Slushy''', also known as '''Experiment 523''', is an illegal [[Experiments|genetic experiment]] created by [[Jumba Jookiba]] and a character in the [[Lilo & Stitch (franchise)|''Lilo & Stitch'' franchise]]. He is designed to be a freeze inducer, making mostly ice and snow. As his deep-freeze programming continues, he creates icy blizzards, mile-high snowdrifts, and keeps all leftovers edible for six months. His one true place is making [[Luki's Shave Ice|shave ice]] with [[Dupe (344)|Dupe]].

==Background and appearances==
Experiment 523 was the 523rd genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. He was designed to make ice and snow, but could use these powers to convert areas into frozen tundras. 523 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch (626)|Experiment 626]].

All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of [[Kauai]], with 523's pod landing atop a vending machine.

===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''===
[[File:Lilo & Stitch The Series - Slushy - Slushy moments after activation.png|thumb|left|Slushy moments after his activation]]
When [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] shook the vending machine while trying to get a soda, 523's pod fell out and rolled into a nearby storm drain, the sewage activating the experiment, whose icy blast froze the grating. After freezing the top of another storm drain at a [[Kauai Airport|helicopter base]], 523 emerged from it and then stowed away aboard a helicopter, where he proceeded to cover the entire [[Kauai|island]] in snow.

Stitch somehow vandalized the soda machine after it malfunctioned before he and [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] discovered the snowy weather in [[Kokaua Town]]. Stitch was disconcerted by the snow, while Lilo became fascinated and dragged Stitch [[Lilo's House|home]] to consult [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], who revealed 523's powers to them.

Later, Lilo and Stitch engaged 523 in battle, resulting in the experiment freezing Stitch in ice. 523 then attempted to do the same to Lilo, but the former was blasted into a [[Net Cannon|net]] and captured in a [[Prison Capsule|containment orb]] by [[Gantu]]. However, when Lilo freed Stitch from the ice with a [[Plasma Blaster|blaster]], the latter managed to get 523 back from Gantu after a brief struggle. 523, named Slushy by Lilo, was then taken back to their house, where Lilo convinced him to cover their dwelling in more snow for a little winter fun.

[[File:Lilo & Stitch The Series - Slushy - Splodyhead versus Slushy.png|thumb|Slushy vs. Splodyhead]]
Although Stitch initially rejected the snow, as it was a form of water, he soon joined Lilo outside and did some ice skating and sledding with her. However, while they were busy playing in the snow, Gantu arrived and recaptured Slushy. The former then forced the experiment to cover the island in a massive blizzard and create a huge, impenetrable ice fortress for Gantu and [[Reuben (625)|Experiment 625]].

Sometime later, Lilo and Stitch traveled to the ice fortress to defeat Slushy. They built two snow replicas of themselves as bait, which Gantu blasted, enabling them to sneak past him and Reuben. However, Slushy spotted Lilo and Stitch inside and managed to trap them under four giant icicles. Fortunately, Jumba and [[Pleakley]] arrived with [[Splodyhead (619)|Splodyhead]], who took on Slushy.

A long-drawn-out battle ensued between Slushy and Splodyhead, which ended when the former froze the latter into a block of ice. Splodyhead was later freed and blasted a fireball into the sky at the top of [[Waialeale Peak]] to clear Slushy's snowstorms, while an overthrown Gantu came down with a cold.

[[File:Lilo & Stitch The Series - Slushy - Slushy making shave ice.png|thumb|left|Slushy making shave ice]]
After Slushy was defeated and recaptured, Lilo and Stitch found him a one true place making [[Luki's Shave Ice|shave ice]].

Slushy reappeared in "[[Elastico (episode)|Elastico]]" as one of the audience members for Lilo's hula dance.

In "[[Angel (episode)|Angel]]", Slushy was one of the experiments that [[Angel (624)|Angel]] reverted to evil using her song, causing the former to go on a rampage by freezing the town (including Stitch and Pleakley). Later, Slushy and the other depraved experiments attacked Stitch aboard a ship, but Angel turned them to good again before they could finish Stitch off. Working together, the experiments were then able to successfully escape the ship with Stitch.

In "[[Spike (episode)|Spike]]", Slushy was one of the experiments in Pleakley's E.A.R.W.A.X. group. When Slushy created and threw a snowball at Pleakley with boredom, it accidentally hit Splodyhead and a battle ensued between the two experiments, which ended when Pleakley convinced Slushy and Splodyhead to attempt hugging therapy on each other.

In "[[Remmy (276)|Remmy]]", Slushy was one of the experiments in Lilo's dream.

Slushy and Splodyhead were seen on a computer screen in "[[Ace (episode)|Ace]]", posing as evil creations of Jumba's as part of a hoax to fool [[Mortlegax]], the head of E.G.O. industries.

[[File:Lilo & Stitch The Series - Snafu - Dupe duplicating shave ice.png|thumb|Slushy with Dupe]]
In "[[Snafu (episode)|Snafu]]", Slushy and [[Dupe (344)|Dupe]] were seen using their combined powers to sell multiple low-calorie shave ice cones that [[Charles and Mary|a couple]] bought and enjoyed. Gantu then attempted to revert the rehabilitated experiments to evil by playing a recording of Angel's song with Reuben's help, but due to interference from [[Snafu (120)|Experiment 120]], Gantu's karaoke tape was played instead, much to Slushy and Dupe's humor.

===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''===
In the film's opening, Slushy can be seen with [[Poki (036)|Poki]] as the former sells shave ice.

Later, the first 624 experiments, including Slushy, were rounded up by [[Leroy (629)|Leroy]] and taken to a [[Aloha Stadium|stadium]] to be destroyed. However, Lilo, [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben (625)|Reuben]] and [[Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed.

Slushy participated in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]] by freezing oncoming waves of attacking Leroys with his ice breath.

However, the Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe.

===[[Stitch!|''Stitch!'' anime]]===
Slushy made [[Meega Going to Disneyland!|an appearance]] in the ''Stitch!'' anime, along with [[Pix (214)|Pix]], [[Boomer (288)|Boomer]], [[Blowhard (533)|Blowhard]], [[Kixx (601)|Kixx]], and [[Slugger (608)|Slugger]], when [[Yuna Kamihara|Yuna]] and [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] visited Tokyo Disneyland. He made [[Stitch Ahoy!|a second appearance]] along with [[Sinker (602)|Sinker]], in which [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] [[Transmutation|used]] both of them to attack a cruise ship that he had lured Stitch onto. After being defeated, Slushy was reverted back to normal, then dehydrated back into an experiment pod and locked in [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]]'s vault. Eventually, Jumba grabbed his pod to help Stitch in his fight against [[Dark End]], but Slushy wasn't one of the experiments that was activated. He later appeared in the specials ''[[Stitch and the Planet of Sand]]'' and ''[[Stitch! Perfect Memory]]''.

==Personality==
Slushy is an icy experiment with a one-track mind. He greatly dislikes the heat, but is very short-tempered about this. He is playful and often likes to play with his "cousins" by starting snowball fights, though sometimes enjoys messing with his victims by making the ground slippery or freezing something they need. He is known to be aggressive and apparently shares a grudge with [[Splodyhead (619)|Splodyhead]] following their initial meeting, though they resolved it in "[[Spike (episode)|Spike]]".

==Biology==
===Physical appearance===
Slushy is a small icy blue-colored koala/penguin/seal-like creature with no ears, small arms and legs, a thin mouth, a large blue-green nose, dark blue eyes and three icicles behind his head.

===Special abilities===
Slushy is a freeze inducer, able to blast gusts of ice and snow ranging from a simple snow-cone to a massive blizzard. In order to better spread his freezing cold breath, he will locate the highest point in the area. The capabilities of his ice blasts vary in strength and intensity. He has also demonstrated an extent of power able to turn a tropical paradise into a winter wonderland. He has the ability to meld weapons with his icy breath, strong enough to repel fire without melting, and taking an extremely concentrated amount of which to do so. Also, his breath is cold enough to freeze plasma blasts into simple clumps of snow.

Slushy has displayed cryokinesis, the ability to manipulate ice in any size, shape or form. When crushed under ice pillars, he suddenly lifted them above him and turned them into a spinning hurricane without touching them, displaying this ability for the first time. To access his cryokinetic power, he takes a deep breath then exhales with great force. Slushy can be easily broken into a shapeless lump of blocks and bits of ice, but he can just as easily regenerate himself. The time period he can stay in this form is unknown, as he has never demonstrated much longer than a few seconds.

Slushy possesses limited airborne mobility (though he has no evident flight or levitation capabilities), including enhanced jumping and his ability to maneuver along coasters of midair icicles, which gradually deteriorate as he goes, and thus can get him a good extra distance.

===Weaknesses===
[[Splodyhead (619)|Splodyhead]] appears to be a near-match for Slushy. He hates fire, which causes him to melt. His ice powers are also weakened if it is too hot. His powers are helped if he is by a water source. He has a little bit of extra strength, but he is weaker when compared to [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] or [[Leroy (629)|Leroy]].

==Trivia==
*When Slushy is activated, Gantu mentions that the ice and snowfields created by Slushy remind him of his home world. He also mentions that he could use Slushy to "turn Earth from a sweltering mud ball into something livable."
*Slushy's [[Experiment Pods|pod]] color is blue.
*The [[Experiment Pod Container]] describes Slushy as: "Experiment 523. Primary function: Freeze inducer."
*In the French dub, his experiment number is 509, a [[:Category:Mislabeled Experiments|number taken by]] [[Sprout (509)|Sprout]], for some unknown reason.
*Slushy appears to share a grudge with [[Splodyhead (619)|Splodyhead]], but they resolved it in "[[Spike (episode)|Spike]]".

'''Snafu''', also known as '''Experiment 120''', is an illegal [[Experiments|genetic experiment]] created by [[Jumba Jookiba]] and a character in the [[Lilo & Stitch (franchise)|''Lilo & Stitch'' franchise]]. He is designed to discombobulate enemy plans by any possible means; he will also thwart any attempt to capture him, and thus can only be caught by accident.

==Background and appearances==
Experiment 120 was the 120th genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. He was designed to foil any and all enemy plans at whatever cost. 120 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch (626)|Experiment 626]].

All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of [[Kauai]].

At an unknown point after this, Experiment 120's pod was found by Jumba and kept in a shoebox under his bed.

===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''===
[[File:Lilo & Stitch The Series - Snafu - Snafu after being activated.png|thumb|left|Snafu after being activated]]
[[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] discovered 120's pod in the shoebox under [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]]'s bed when she was searching around his room for any unactivated experiments to use in a rescue mission to free [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]]'s cousins on [[Gantu's Ship|Gantu's ship]]. However, Jumba took 120's pod from Lilo and revealed its design. 

Jumba warned Lilo not to use 120, as he was the worst experiment to activate when making complex rescue missions. Just then, [[Pleakley]] foolishly came in with a hose and sprayed water everywhere, which got 120's pod wet, activating the experiment. 120 ripped up the blueprints for Lilo and Stitch's rescue mission and then escaped through the pet flap.

120 remained near the [[Lilo's House|Pelekai residence]], where he cleverly spied on Lilo, Stitch and the experiments' plans for the rescue mission and sabotaged their obstacle course, which put a damper on things.

[[File:Lilo & Stitch The Series - Snafu - Snafu switching Gantu's cassette tapes.png|thumb|Snafu switching Gantu's tapes]]
120 later foiled [[Gantu]]'s plan to revert all of the rehabilitated experiments to evil by swapping the tape of [[Angel (624)|Angel]]'s song with Gantu's karaoke tape. When the tape was played by [[Reuben (625)|Experiment 625]] driving a stolen ice cream truck, everyone in [[Kokaua Town|town]] became awestruck and laughed in amusement, thinking it was a prank, much to Gantu's embarrassment.

When Lilo, Stitch and the experiments launched a rescue mission on the ship, 120 tricked [[Sample (258)|Sample]] into imitating the ship's alarm to alert Gantu. 120 then rewired the ship's prison, causing it to trap Lilo and the rescue team.

However, 120, named Snafu, did not count on the prison trapping him as well. Though after hearing Stitch confess his love for Angel, Snafu cried because it really touched his heart, causing him to turn from bad to good.

[[File:Lilo & Stitch The Series - Snafu - Snafu 'accidentally' captured.png|thumb|left|Snafu "accidentally" captured]]
Fortunately, Snafu was freed by Angel and Stitch, who also freed Lilo and the other captive experiments in their [[Prison Capsule|containment orbs]]. Snafu then foiled Gantu before the latter could recapture the experiments and escaped the ship with Lilo, the rescue team, and the released experiments.

===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''===
The first 624 experiments, including Snafu, were rounded up by [[Leroy (629)|Leroy]] and taken to a [[Aloha Stadium|stadium]] to be destroyed. However, Lilo, [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben (625)|Reuben]] and [[Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed.

It is unknown whether or not Snafu participated in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]].

The Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe.

==Personality==
Snafu is a mischievous, cunning, and conniving experiment. This is proven when he turned all of Lilo and Stitch's plans to save the imprisoned experiments in Gantu's ship against them, and also sabotaged Gantu's plans to turn all the remaining experiments from good to bad by swapping the tape of Angel's song with Gantu's karaoke tape. However, his desire to foil plans seems to come from his programming, and he is initially unable to distinguish friend and foe.

Snafu seems to be somewhat sadistic, as he laughs every time he manages to foil a plan. Since he was programmed to sabotage enemy plans by any possible means, he is very resourceful, with even Jumba acknowledging that he can only be caught by accident. The only thing Snafu hates the most is having his own sabotage backfire on him. However, after Stitch revealed his love to Angel, Snafu became touched while shedding tears and changed his heart.

==Biology==
===Physical appearance===
Snafu is a small dark green/teal cephalopod-like experiment with a roughly reptilian face with wide mouth, small white eyes with black pupils, a small round body, little arms and legs with small hands and feet, little tail, black markings on his back and six telescoping prehensile tentacles on his large dome head; three on each end of his head.

===Special abilities===
Snafu is a master at foiling any and all complex plans. He is also highly elusive due to his plan-foiling skills, and can only be captured or defeated by accident. His tentacles are elastic, able to retract into small lumps on his head, and he often uses them for mobility or gripping objects. His eyes can serve as magnifying lenses, and he has the incredible ability to tamper with machines.

===Weaknesses===
Apparently, when foiling complex plans, Snafu doesn't always anticipate his actions backfiring on him. He can also be caught while vulnerable, but only by accident.

==Trivia==
*Snafu is named after the acronym [[wikipedia:SNAFU|SNAFU]] ('''S'''ituation '''N'''ormal: '''A'''ll '''F'''ouled '''U'''p).
*According to Jumba, Snafu is a "havoc wreaker of all havoc wreakers."
*Snafu's [[Experiment Pods|pod]] color is purple.
*The [[Experiment Pod Container]] describes Snafu as: "Experiment 120. Primary function: Discombobulates enemy plans."
*Snafu is one of the few experiments to not have his one true place revealed.
*He is one of the few experiments to have visible sclerae.
*He is also one of the few experiments to not appear in the group photo at the end of ''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''.

'''Snooty''', also known as '''Experiment 277''', is an illegal [[Experiments|genetic experiment]] created by [[Jumba Jookiba]] and a character in the [[Lilo & Stitch (franchise)|''Lilo & Stitch'' franchise]]. He is designed to mine and enrich Snootonium, a rare intergalactic energy source that becomes unstable and dangerous once enriched. Luckily, there is none on Earth, which [[Gantu]] sees as no reason to capture Snooty, only doing so under [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s orders. However, Snootonium has a similar chemical composition to mucus, and thus his programming draws him to individuals with large quantities. His one true place is as [[Victoria]]'s pet, clearing her sinuses.

==Background and appearances==
Experiment 277 was the 277th genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. He was designed to mine and enrich Snootonium, a rare element that has a similar chemical composition as Earth mucus. 277 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch (626)|Experiment 626]].

All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of [[Kauai]].

===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''===
[[File:ScreenCapture-19-09-23-11h24m05s514.png|thumb|left|Snooty moments after his activation]]
277's pod eventually made its way onto a pickup truck's antenna. When the owner took the dirty pickup through a car wash, the pod got wet in the wash, activating the experiment. After spooking the pickup's driver, 277 left in search of mucus (considering the fact that there was no Snootonium available on Earth).

Drawn by her allergies, 277 frequently attacked [[Victoria]], who mistook him for a real vampire, but each time he was warded off by [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]]. They also prevented an impetuous [[Gantu]] from capturing the experiment, despite Victoria's protests. When Lilo later looked up 277 on [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]]'s [[Jumba's Computer|computer]], she informed Victoria that 277 was not an actual vampire and didn't need to be slain or feared once rehabilitated, although Victoria remained wary.

[[File:ScreenCapture-19-09-23-12h10m04s839.jpg|thumb|Snooty sucking out Stitch's mucus]]
Later, when Lilo and Victoria were out looking for 277, named Snooty, he made another attempt on Victoria, prompting her to hide in [[Officer Kahiko]]'s police car. During this assault, Stitch bravely challenged the bat-like experiment. Snooty, upon detecting the visible mucus in Stitch's body, attacked the latter and sucked him dry. After Snooty put Stitch out of commission, Victoria vowed to slay the former if she had to do it without Lilo's help.

When Lilo brought a weak and fatigued Stitch [[Lilo's House|home]], Jumba explained that Stitch's body was 62.7% mucus that had been drained out, temporarily weakening him. Jumba then revealed that mucus had a chemical composition similar to Snootonium, despite it being unavailable on Earth. This also explained why Snooty kept going after Victoria.

Meanwhile, Victoria was in a hardware store looking for items to slay Snooty with. She then noticed Gantu using the store's TV set (since [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] had supposedly cut Gantu's cable service earlier according to [[Reuben (625)|Experiment 625]]) and decided to team up with him to slay the experiment. Using Gantu's [[Manta Shuttle|shuttle]], the two tracked Snooty down to his cave in the Hawaiian mountains, where Gantu used Victoria as bait to successfully draw Snooty out.

[[File:ScreenCapture-19-09-23-12h52m22s221.jpg|thumb|left|Snooty with Victoria]]
Lilo soon arrived with [[Pleakley]] and was shocked to see Victoria consorting with Gantu. She claimed that Gantu was helping her slay Snooty, but Lilo managed to convince Victoria of his treachery. Gantu blasted Snooty into a [[Net Cannon|net]], but the latter was then saved by Victoria and Lilo, who both fought Gantu for the experiment.

After being freed, Snooty rested contentedly in Victoria's arms. When Snooty used his mucus-sucking power to clear Victoria's sinuses, the latter kept him as a pet.

===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''===
In the film's opening, Snooty can be seen waving hello to [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], along with [[Babyfier (151)|Babyfier]] and [[Amnesio (303)|Amnesio]].

Later, the first 624 experiments, including Snooty, were rounded up by [[Leroy (629)|Leroy]] and taken to a [[Aloha Stadium|stadium]] to be destroyed. However, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben (625)|Reuben]] and [[Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed.

Snooty participated in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]] by dodging Leroys' plasma projectiles and possibly draining Leroys' mucus.

However, the Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe.

==Personality==
Snooty is a single-minded experiment dedicated to mining and enriching Snootonium. There is none on Earth, but Snootonium has a similar chemical composition to mucus, so his programming draws him to individuals with large quantities of mucus, such as Victoria and Stitch (his body is 62.7% mucus). Unlike most experiments, Snooty is not inherently vile and is one of the more tame experiments that will avoid harming others in his search. However, he will defend himself if he is provoked and is very persistent in fulfilling his primary function.

==Biology==
===Physical appearance===
Snooty is a small, light purple bat-like experiment with a triangular body, stumpy legs, two fingers and a thumb on each of his wings, hardly any neck, a wide mouth with two fangs, two little nostrils, pointed ears and black eyes.

===Special abilities===
Snooty sees in an unidentified vision spectrum that allows him to detect Snootonium (similar to how snakes' infrared vision allows them to detect body heat).

He can also mine and enrich Snootonium and/or mucus by using his mouth/fangs; in the latter's case, sucking it from a victim's nostrils in seconds.

In order to fulfill his primary function, Snooty can perform some [https://www.britannica.com/science/isotope/Isotope-separation-and-enrichment advanced science], as there are several ways to enrich an element's isotopes. It is unclear which method is built into Snooty's biology, but he appears to create some sort of pod to contain Snootonium (though in [[Snooty (episode)|his episode]], it is mucus) that he mounts to objects, such as the cave walls of his lair.

==Trivia==
